pairs.target: dìèrtiān , lín zhào dàohuò péng shí , jiēshàng de dēng hái méi xī .
pairs.english: When Lin Zhao reached the freight shed the next day, the street lamps had not yet gone out.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天，林照到货棚时，街上的灯还没熄。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yāodài wǎng yījīn dǐxià àn le àn .
pairs.english: She pressed the waist pouch beneath her jacket.
pairs.hanzi: 她把腰袋往衣襟底下按了按。

pairs.target: liǎngkuài gān bǐng , jǐtiáo gānjìng bù , háiyǒu yìxiǎobāo chǎo dòu , dōu zhuāng zài lǐmiàn , zǒu kuài xiē , dòuzǐ biàn tiēzhe dùpí qīngqīng xiǎng .
pairs.english: Two pieces of flatbread, a few strips of clean cloth, and a small packet of roasted beans were all packed inside; walking faster made the beans rattle softly against her belly.
pairs.hanzi: 两块干饼、几条干净布，还有一小包炒豆，都装在里面，走快些，豆子便贴着肚皮轻轻响。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn gěi tā liú le dàbàn bāo , zìjǐ zhī jiǎn zǒu jǐkē , shuō shì shěngde tā lùshang xián zuǐ dàn .
pairs.english: Aunt Zhou had left most of the packet for her, taking only a few beans herself, saying it was so she wouldn't complain of having nothing to snack on along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶给她留了大半包，自己只拣走几颗，说是省得她路上嫌嘴淡。

pairs.target: péng ménwài tíng zhe yíliàng luóchē .
pairs.english: A mule cart stood outside the shed door.
pairs.hanzi: 棚门外停着一辆骡车。

pairs.target: zuówǎn pái hǎo de bèi jià yǐjīng bān dào chē páng , shào píng dūn zài qízhōng yífù qián , zhèng wǎng wài chōu shéng .
pairs.english: The frames arranged last night had been moved beside the cart already; Shao Ping was crouching before one of them, busy pulling rope out.
pairs.hanzi: 昨晚排好的背架已经搬到车旁，邵平蹲在其中一副前，正往外抽绳。

pairs.target: " láide qiǎo , dā bǎshǒu . "
pairs.english: “Good timing; lend a hand.”
pairs.hanzi: “来得巧，搭把手。”

pairs.target: lín zhào jiē zhù shéngquān , mō chū shéng lǐ cáng zhe yì jié tiě kòu , biàn zhīdào búshì zuórì zhuāng hǎo de nà kǔn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao caught the coil, felt a short iron clasp hidden in the rope, and knew this was not the bundle packed yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 林照接住绳圈，摸出绳里藏着一截铁扣，便知道不是昨日装好的那捆。

pairs.target: " tiān de ? "
pairs.english: “An addition?”
pairs.hanzi: “添的？”

pairs.target: " zuówǎn tànlù de huílái shuō , xià tóu yǒu yíduàn shī jiē , yào duō dài liǎngfù diàosuǒ . "
pairs.english: “The scouts returned last night saying there's a stretch of wet steps below; we need to carry an extra two sets of hauling lines.”
pairs.hanzi: “昨晚探路的回来说，下头有一段湿阶，要多带两副吊索。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ yúxià nà fù yě tíchū lái .
pairs.english: He lifted out the remaining set as well.
pairs.hanzi: 他把余下那副也提出来。

pairs.target: dìshàng de kōng dàikǒu cháo shàng zhāng zhe , liú zhe huílái zhuāng dōngxī , rújīn zài tiān diàosuǒ , héngmù shàng biàn zhī shèng yìxiǎo jié néng bǎng dōngxī de dìfāng .
pairs.english: The empty sack lay on the ground with its mouth gaping upward, reserved for carrying things back; adding hauling lines now would leave only a small stretch of space on the crossbar for tying items.
pairs.hanzi: 地上的空袋口朝上张着，留着回来装东西，如今再添吊索，横木上便只剩一小截能绑东西的地方。

pairs.target: " huílái zěnme fàng ? "
pairs.english: “Where will it all go on the way back?”
pairs.hanzi: “回来怎么放？”

pairs.target: lín zhào wèn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao asked.
pairs.hanzi: 林照问。

pairs.target: shào píng méi dá , chōng cóng wūlǐ chūlái de fāng jǐn zhāo le zhāoshǒu .
pairs.english: Shao Ping did not answer, but beckoned to Fang Jin as he came out of the room.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平没答，冲从屋里出来的方谨招了招手。

pairs.target: fāng jǐn tīng wán , jiāng shǒulǐ de cèzǐ fān dào jiá qiān nà yè , méitóu wēiwēi yí zhòu .
pairs.english: After listening, Fang Jin turned the booklet in his hand to the bookmarked page, his brow creasing slightly.
pairs.hanzi: 方谨听完，将手里的册子翻到夹签那页，眉头微微一皱。

pairs.target: " xiāoxī láide chí , xiān jì zài nǐmen liǎnggè míngxià le .
pairs.english: “The news came late, so I put them under your two names for now.
pairs.hanzi: “消息来得迟，先记在你们两个名下了。

pairs.target: nǐmen kàn néng bunéng ——"
pairs.english: Could you two perhaps—”
pairs.hanzi: 你们看能不能——”

pairs.target: " nuó yífù gěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Move one set to me.”
pairs.hanzi: “挪一副给我。”

pairs.target: shēngyīn cóng chē hòu chuánlái .
pairs.english: The voice came from behind the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 声音从车后传来。

pairs.target: lín zhào huítóu , yígè chuān shēn qīng duǎn páo de niánqīngrén zhèng bǎ jiàn xì zài yāojiān , xiùkǒu shù dé zhěngqí .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao turned; a young man in a dark teal tunic was fastening a sword at his waist, his cuffs bound neatly.
pairs.hanzi: 林照回头，一个穿深青短袍的年轻人正把剑系在腰间，袖口束得整齐。

pairs.target: tā xiān kànjiàn tā wòzhù jiànqiào de shǒu , zài kànjiàn liǎn , hūrán rènchū le gàoshì shàng nàge rén .
pairs.english: First she saw his hand gripping the scabbard, then noticed his face and suddenly recognized the man on the notices.
pairs.hanzi: 她先看见他握住剑鞘的手，再看见脸，忽然认出了告示上那个人。

pairs.target: huàxiàng shàng de shěn yàn zhōu zǒng xiàng zài wàng zhe hěn yuǎn de dìfāng , yǎnqián zhège què dīzhetóu , zài zhǎo diàosuǒ de shéng tóu .
pairs.english: In his portraits, Shen Yanzhou always seemed to be gazing somewhere far away; before her now, though, he had his head down, looking for the end of a hauling line.
pairs.hanzi: 画像上的沈砚舟总像在望着很远的地方，眼前这个却低着头，在找吊索的绳头。

pairs.target: " èr gōngzǐ , zhège zhān yīshang . "
pairs.english: “Second Young Master, that will stain your clothes,”
pairs.hanzi: “二公子，这个沾衣裳。”

pairs.target: fāng jǐn shuō .
pairs.english: Fang Jin said.
pairs.hanzi: 方谨说。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu mōlemō shéng shàng de yóu , jiēguò qù , ràochéng yìquān .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou felt the oil on the rope, took it, and wound it into a loop.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟摸了摸绳上的油，接过去，绕成一圈。

pairs.target: " lìng yífù , dùhéng , nǐ dài ? "
pairs.english: “Du Heng, could you carry the other set?”
pairs.hanzi: “另一副，杜衡，你带？”

pairs.target: chē páng de dàgèzi yìng le yìshēng , téngchū yòushǒu .
pairs.english: The big man beside the cart answered and freed his right hand.
pairs.hanzi: 车旁的大个子应了一声，腾出右手。

pairs.target: tā zuǒbì wǎn zhe yímiàn méngpí dùn , fāngcái yìzhí yòng mǔzhǐ ànzhe dùn dài , xiàngshì zài shì sōngjǐn .
pairs.english: His left arm held a hide-covered shield; he had been pressing its strap with his thumb, as though testing the fit.
pairs.hanzi: 他左臂挽着一面蒙皮盾，方才一直用拇指按着盾带，像是在试松紧。

pairs.target: shào píng bǎ kōng dài chóngxīn juàn hǎo , sāi huí héngmù dǐxià .
pairs.english: Shao Ping rolled up the empty sack again and tucked it beneath the crossbar.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平把空袋重新卷好，塞回横木底下。

pairs.target: lín zhào yě gēnzhe shōu shéng , xiōngkǒu nà yìdiǎn yuánběn zhǔnbèi nálái zhēngbiàn de qì , hūrán méi le qùchù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao followed suit, gathering rope too; the little breath in her chest, originally held ready for arguing, suddenly had nowhere to go.
pairs.hanzi: 林照也跟着收绳，胸口那一点原本准备拿来争辩的气，忽然没了去处。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu jiāng diàosuǒ kòu zài bèináng wài , wèn : " zhèyàng hái néng liú duōshǎo ? "
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou fastened the hauling line to the outside of his pack and asked, “How much room does that still leave?”
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟将吊索扣在背囊外，问：“这样还能留多少？”

pairs.target: shào píng shēnshǒu bǐ le gè dàxiǎo .
pairs.english: Shao Ping held out a hand to indicate the size.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平伸手比了个大小。

pairs.target: " xíng .
pairs.english: “All right.

pairs.target: bùnéng zhuāng de bié yìng sāi , dào le dìfāng zài fēn . "
pairs.english: Don't force in what won't fit; we'll divide things up when we're there.”
pairs.hanzi: 不能装的别硬塞，到了地方再分。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn qù kàn chēlún , méi děng shuí dàoxiè .
pairs.english: With that, he went to check the wheels without waiting for anyone's thanks.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完便去看车轮，没等谁道谢。

pairs.target: lín zhào dītóu xì hǎo shéngkòu , rěnbúzhù yòu kàn le yìyǎn tā de bèináng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao lowered her head to secure the rope fastening, but could not help glancing at his pack once more.
pairs.hanzi: 林照低头系好绳扣，忍不住又看了一眼他的背囊。

pairs.target: zuóyè tā hái xiǎng guò , tǎngruò jiàn shū chíchí bù qiān , zìjǐ gāi zěnme kāikǒu .
pairs.english: Last night she had wondered, too, how she should ask if the reference stayed unsigned.
pairs.hanzi: 昨夜她还想过，倘若荐书迟迟不签，自己该怎么开口。

pairs.target: yǎnxià juéde , dǎo yě wèibì nàme nán .
pairs.english: Now it seemed it might not be so difficult after all.
pairs.hanzi: 眼下觉得，倒也未必那么难。

pairs.target: tiānliàng hòu , yìxíng rén chū le chéng .
pairs.english: After dawn, the party left the city.
pairs.hanzi: 天亮后，一行人出了城。

pairs.target: luóchē yánhé dī zǒu , yuǎnchù de huò lóu zhújiàn tuì dào liǔshù hòutou .
pairs.english: The mule cart rolled along the river embankment; the distant warehouses gradually receded behind the willows.
pairs.hanzi: 骡车沿河堤走，远处的货楼逐渐退到柳树后头。

pairs.target: lín zhào gēn zài chē páng , lùguò yíchù shěnjiā de huò yuàn , kànjiàn ménnèi diàojià huǎnhuǎn shēngqǐ , jià xià liǎnggè rén kōng zhuóshǒu , zhǐguǎn fúzhèng huòxiāng .
pairs.english: Walking beside the cart, Lin Zhao passed a Shen family freight yard and saw a hoist rising slowly inside the gate; the two men beneath it had their hands free, needing only to steady the crate.
pairs.hanzi: 林照跟在车旁，路过一处沈家的货院，看见门内吊架缓缓升起，架下两个人空着手，只管扶正货箱。

pairs.target: qiáng wài de xiǎo jiǎofū men què hái tái zhe mábāo wǎng pō shàng nuó , yì rén hǎn hào , jǐgè rén yìqí wānyāo .
pairs.english: Outside the wall, though, the young porters were still shouldering burlap sacks up the slope, one calling the rhythm as several bent together.
pairs.hanzi: 墙外的小脚夫们却还抬着麻包往坡上挪，一人喊号，几个人一齐弯腰。

pairs.target: nà diàojià lǐ yòng le duōshǎo jīngshí , tā bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: She did not know how many crystals were used inside that hoist.
pairs.hanzi: 那吊架里用了多少晶石，她不知道。

pairs.target: zhōu shěn zuògōng de dìfāng yě yǒu yìtái , huài le xiǎo bànnián , gōngtóu zǒng shuō děng xià yuè xiū .
pairs.english: There was one where Aunt Zhou worked too, broken for nearly half a year; the foreman always said he would have it repaired next month.
pairs.hanzi: 周婶做工的地方也有一台，坏了小半年，工头总说等下月修。

pairs.target: chēlǐ hūrán chuánlái yízhèn qīng xiǎng .
pairs.english: A faint rattling suddenly came from inside the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 车里忽然传来一阵轻响。

pairs.target: lín zhào yǐwéi shì yóuhú pèng le , shēnshǒu qù fú , kàojìn cái fāxiàn , shì yìzhī biǎnpíng mùxiá lǐ de xì zhēn zài chàn .
pairs.english: Thinking the oil flasks had knocked together, Lin Zhao reached out to steady them; only up close did she discover it was the fine needle inside a flat wooden case that was trembling.
pairs.hanzi: 林照以为是油壶碰了，伸手去扶，靠近才发现，是一只扁平木匣里的细针在颤。

pairs.target: xiá gài xiān zhe , lǐtou qiàn zhe bàntòumíng de jīngpiàn , zhēnjiān xiàfú qǐ yíxiàn wēiguāng , xiàng rìtou zhàojìn báobīng .
pairs.english: The lid was raised, revealing an inset translucent crystal wafer; a thread of pale light rose beneath the needle tip, like sunlight entering thin ice.
pairs.hanzi: 匣盖掀着，里头嵌着半透明的晶片，针尖下浮起一线微光，像日头照进薄冰。

pairs.target: tā de shǒu tíng zài bànkōng .
pairs.english: Her hand stopped in midair.
pairs.hanzi: 她的手停在半空。

pairs.target: " búshì gěi nǐ kàn de . "
pairs.english: “This isn't for you to look at.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是给你看的。”

pairs.target: zuòzài chēyán de nǚrén hé shàng xiá gài , jiāng tā wǎng shēnbiān yí le yí .
pairs.english: The woman sitting on the cart's edge closed the lid and shifted it closer to her side.
pairs.hanzi: 坐在车沿的女人合上匣盖，将它往身边移了移。

pairs.target: tā tóufa wǎn dé hěn qí , ěrbiān lián yìgēn sànfā yě méiyǒu , tái yǎn shí , méishāo de húdù qīngqīngchǔchǔ .
pairs.english: Her hair was pinned very neatly, without even a single stray strand beside her ear; when she looked up, the curve of each brow was sharply defined.
pairs.hanzi: 她头发挽得很齐，耳边连一根散发也没有，抬眼时，眉梢的弧度清清楚楚。

pairs.target: zuórì xiàngkǒu mài yānzhī de fùrén yě huà zhe zhèyàng de méi , què yìbiān gāo yìbiān dī .
pairs.english: The woman selling rouge at the alley mouth yesterday had painted brows like those too, but one was higher than the other.
pairs.hanzi: 昨日巷口卖胭脂的妇人也画着这样的眉，却一边高一边低。

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu shōuhuí lái .
pairs.english: She withdrew her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她把手收回来。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǐwéi dōngxī sōng le . "
pairs.english: “I thought something had come loose.”
pairs.hanzi: “我以为东西松了。”

pairs.target: nǚrén méi dá , zhuǎntóu cháo qiánmiàn shuō : " yàn zhōu , wǔhòu dào le , xiān ràng wǒ fù yíbiàn lù , biéjí zhe xià . "
pairs.english: The woman did not answer, but turned to call ahead, “Yanzhou, when we arrive this afternoon, let me check the route once more first; don't rush down.”
pairs.hanzi: 女人没答，转头朝前面说：“砚舟，午后到了，先让我复一遍路，别急着下。”

pairs.target: " tīng nǐ de . "
pairs.english: “As you say,”
pairs.hanzi: “听你的。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu shuō .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou said.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟说。

pairs.target: nà nǚrén xiào le yíxià , shǒu réng dā zài mùxiá shàng .
pairs.english: The woman smiled briefly, her hand still resting on the wooden case.
pairs.hanzi: 那女人笑了一下，手仍搭在木匣上。

pairs.target: shào píng luòhòu liǎngbù , děng lín zhào zǒu dào pángbiān , cái dīshēng dào : " xǔ cén , rènlù de .
pairs.english: Shao Ping dropped back two steps, waited until Lin Zhao was beside him, then said quietly, “Xu Cen, our navigator.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平落后两步，等林照走到旁边，才低声道：“许岑，认路的。

pairs.target: tā méi jiào nǐ dòng , jiù biédòng . "
pairs.english: Unless she tells you to touch it, leave it alone.”
pairs.hanzi: 她没叫你动，就别动。”

pairs.target: lín zhào diǎndiǎntóu , yǎnjīng què yòu wǎng xiázǐ shàng liū le yìhuí .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao nodded, yet her eyes strayed toward the case once more.
pairs.hanzi: 林照点点头，眼睛却又往匣子上溜了一回。

pairs.target: fāngcái nà diǎn guāng , gé zhe gàibǎn fǎngfú hái liúzài lǐmiàn .
pairs.english: That little light from earlier seemed still to linger inside, even through the lid.
pairs.hanzi: 方才那点光，隔着盖板仿佛还留在里面。

pairs.target: tā tīng rén shuō cè jù néng biàn kū lǐ de qiángruò , yuánlái zhēn néng zuò dé zhèyàng xiǎo .
pairs.english: She had heard people say instruments could gauge the intensity of dungeons; it turned out they really could be made this small.
pairs.hanzi: 她听人说测具能辨窟里的强弱，原来真能做得这样小。

pairs.target: zǒuguò dī wěi , lù kāishǐ wǎng shānlǐ zhé .
pairs.english: Beyond the end of the embankment, the road began turning into the hills.
pairs.hanzi: 走过堤尾，路开始往山里折。

pairs.target: luóchē yuè zǒu yuèmàn , dùhéng tíng zài lùpáng , jiāng dùn gē zài xī shàng .
pairs.english: As the cart slowed further and further, Du Heng stopped beside the road and rested his shield on his knee.
pairs.hanzi: 骡车越走越慢，杜衡停在路旁，将盾搁在膝上。

pairs.target: yígè xiùkǒu zhājǐn de nánrén zǒu guòqù , niē le niē tā de shǒuwàn .
pairs.english: A man with tightly bound cuffs walked over and squeezed his wrist.
pairs.hanzi: 一个袖口扎紧的男人走过去，捏了捏他的手腕。

pairs.target: " má dào nǎér le ? "
pairs.english: “How far has the numbness spread?”
pairs.hanzi: “麻到哪儿了？”

pairs.target: " méi má . "
pairs.english: “It's not numb.”
pairs.hanzi: “没麻。”

pairs.target: " nà sōngkāi gěi wǒ kàn . "
pairs.english: “Then open your hand and let me see.”
pairs.hanzi: “那松开给我看。”

pairs.target: dùhéng zhāngkāi shǒu , zhǎngxīn yídào hóng yìn .
pairs.english: Du Heng opened his hand; a red welt crossed his palm.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡张开手，掌心一道红印。

pairs.target: nà rén tì tā chóngxīn diàn hǎo dùn dài , jiāng kòuzǐ wǎng wài nuó le bàngé .
pairs.english: The man repadded the shield strap for him, shifting the buckle outward by half a notch.
pairs.hanzi: 那人替他重新垫好盾带，将扣子往外挪了半格。

pairs.target: " wēn shù , dàihuìer shàngpō , wǒ de yě kànkàn . "
pairs.english: “Wen Shu, when we climb the slope, check mine too,”
pairs.hanzi: “温述，待会儿上坡，我的也看看。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu huítóu shuō .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou called back.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟回头说。

pairs.target: wēn shù yìng le , xiān bǎ shèngxià de ruǎnbù shōuhuí dàizhōng .
pairs.english: Wen Shu answered, first returning the remaining soft cloth to his bag.
pairs.hanzi: 温述应了，先把剩下的软布收回袋中。

pairs.target: lín zhào cóng tā shēnbiān zǒuguò shí , wénjiàn yìgǔ dàndànde yàowèi .
pairs.english: As Lin Zhao walked close by him, she caught a faint medicinal scent.
pairs.hanzi: 林照从他身边走过时，闻见一股淡淡的药味。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , tāmen dào le fèi shíchǎng .
pairs.english: In the afternoon, they reached the disused quarry.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，他们到了废石场。

pairs.target: shānbì xià dā zhe jǐzuò péng , shuān shēngkǒu de mùzhuāng yìzhí pái dào lùbiān .
pairs.english: Several sheds stood beneath the rock face, with tethering posts for livestock running all the way to the roadside.
pairs.hanzi: 山壁下搭着几座棚，拴牲口的木桩一直排到路边。

pairs.target: liǎngmíng chuān zào yī de rén shǒu zài shānmén qián , shōu le fāng jǐn dì qù de wénshū , cái chè kāi hénggān .
pairs.english: Two men in black uniforms guarded the gate; after receiving the papers Fang Jin handed over, only then did they remove the crossbar.
pairs.hanzi: 两名穿皂衣的人守在栅门前，收了方谨递去的文书，才撤开横杆。

pairs.target: zài wǎng lǐ , dìshàng yǒu yídào xīn wā de qiǎngōu , gékāi chēmǎ hé kào yá de kòngdì .
pairs.english: Farther in, there was a newly dug shallow ditch in the ground, separating the carts and animals from an open space beside the cliff.
pairs.hanzi: 再往里，地上有一道新挖的浅沟，隔开车马和靠崖的空地。

pairs.target: lín zhào xiānqián sòng guò jǐhuí huò , zuìyuǎn yě jiù dào zhèyàng de péngzǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao had made a few deliveries before, reaching only as far as sheds like these.
pairs.hanzi: 林照先前送过几回货，最远也就到这样的棚子。

pairs.target: nàshí xièwán biàn néng zǒu , juéxǐng zhě zài shānmén lǐ zuò shénme , tā zhī tīngjiàn guò jǐjù zhēngzhí hé ǒuěr chuánchū de xiàoshēng .
pairs.english: Then, unloading done, she could leave; as for what the awakened did behind the gate, she had heard only a few arguments and occasional laughter from within.
pairs.hanzi: 那时卸完便能走，觉醒者在栅门里做什么，她只听见过几句争执和偶尔传出的笑声。

pairs.target: zhèhuí luóchē tíng le , tā què dé bèishàng zìjǐ de nà yífù .
pairs.english: This time the mule cart stopped, but she had to shoulder her own frame.
pairs.hanzi: 这回骡车停了，她却得背上自己的那一副。

pairs.target: shào píng bāng tā táiqǐ héngmù .
pairs.english: Shao Ping helped her lift the crossbar.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平帮她抬起横木。

pairs.target: tā zhànwěn , jiāntóu yì jǐn , shúxī de fènliàng yāxiàlái , dǎo jiào xīnlǐ tàshí le xiē .
pairs.english: She steadied herself, shoulders tensing as the familiar weight pressed down; it actually made her feel a little more settled inside.
pairs.hanzi: 她站稳，肩头一紧，熟悉的分量压下来，倒叫心里踏实了些。

pairs.target: fāng jǐn cóng chēshàng qǔ xià mùxiá , jiāogěi xǔ cén , yòu bǎ yìzhāng zhé hǎo de zhǐ dìgěi shěn yàn zhōu .
pairs.english: Fang Jin removed the wooden case from the cart and handed it to Xu Cen, then handed Shen Yanzhou a sheet of folded paper.
pairs.hanzi: 方谨从车上取下木匣，交给许岑，又把一张折好的纸递给沈砚舟。

pairs.target: " wàitou háishì wǒ shǒu zhe .
pairs.english: “I will still keep watch outside.
pairs.hanzi: “外头还是我守着。

pairs.target: dōngxī ruò yào bǔ , ànshuō hǎo de dìfāng liú xìn . "
pairs.english: If you need more supplies, leave word at the place we agreed on.”
pairs.hanzi: 东西若要补，按说好的地方留信。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu jiē le zhǐ .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou took the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟接了纸。

pairs.target: yìzhí zhàn zài tā shēnpáng de nǚzǐ fǔshēn jiǎnchá jiàn náng , tīngjiàn tā shuōhuà biàn táiqǐ tóu .
pairs.english: The woman who had stood at his side all along bent to check her quiver and, hearing him speak, lifted her head.
pairs.hanzi: 一直站在他身旁的女子俯身检查箭囊，听见他说话便抬起头。

pairs.target: tā bǐ xǔ cén gāo , méi wěi yǒu yídào qiǎn bā , bèishàng de gōng yòngbù chán zhe , lín zhàokàn bù chū shì shénme liàozǐ .
pairs.english: She was taller than Xu Cen, with a faint scar at the tail of one brow; the bow on her back was wrapped in cloth, and Lin Zhao could not tell what it was made of.
pairs.hanzi: 她比许岑高，眉尾有一道浅疤，背上的弓用布缠着，林照看不出是什么料子。

alignment.english: at the tail of one brow

pairs.target: " qī lán , zǒu ba . "
pairs.english: “Qi Lan, let's go.”
pairs.hanzi: “戚岚，走吧。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng jiàn náng kòuhǎo , gēn le shàngqù .
pairs.english: She fastened the quiver and followed him.
pairs.hanzi: 她将箭囊扣好，跟了上去。

pairs.target: lín zhàoshù le shù qiánmiàn de rén , jiāshàng zìjǐ , qīgè .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao counted the people ahead: including herself, seven.
pairs.hanzi: 林照数了数前面的人，加上自己，七个。

pairs.target: fāng jǐn méi guò nà dào gōu , zhèng dītóu gēn shǒuménrén shuō zhe shénme .
pairs.english: Fang Jin had not crossed the ditch; he was looking down, saying something to the gatekeeper.
pairs.hanzi: 方谨没过那道沟，正低头跟守门人说着什么。

pairs.target: chēshàng de yóubù cái xiānkāi yíbàn , luózǐ hái zài shuǎi wěiba , yíqiè dōu xiàng xúncháng xièhuò de wǔhòu .
pairs.english: The oilcloth on the cart was only half lifted, the mule was still swishing its tail, and everything looked like an ordinary afternoon of unloading.
pairs.hanzi: 车上的油布才掀开一半，骡子还在甩尾巴，一切都像寻常卸货的午后。

pairs.target: zhuǎnguò yìduī suìshí , qiántou de rén què tíng le .
pairs.english: Rounding a heap of broken stone, they found the people in front had stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 转过一堆碎石，前头的人却停了。

pairs.target: yá jiǎo shù zhe liǎnggēn mùzhù , zhù jiān lán le yídào shéng .
pairs.english: Two wooden posts stood at the foot of the cliff, with a rope strung between them.
pairs.hanzi: 崖脚竖着两根木柱，柱间拦了一道绳。

alignment.english: at the foot of the cliff

pairs.target: shéng hòu běngāi shì yánbì de dìfāng , lùchū yíduàn huībái shíjiē , jiē shàng jī zhe shuǐ , yǔdiǎn zhèng mìmì dì luò zài shàngtóu .
pairs.english: Beyond the rope, where rock should have been, a stretch of pale gray steps lay exposed; water pooled on the steps, and rain was falling thickly over them.
pairs.hanzi: 绳后本该是岩壁的地方，露出一段灰白石阶，阶上积着水，雨点正密密地落在上头。

pairs.target: lín zhào yǎngqǐ liǎn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao raised her face.
pairs.hanzi: 林照仰起脸。

pairs.target: tóudǐng de tiānliàng dé fābái , bàn duǒ yún yě méiyǒu .
pairs.english: The sky overhead was white with brightness, without so much as half a cloud.
pairs.hanzi: 头顶的天亮得发白，半朵云也没有。

pairs.target: xǔ cén dǎkāi mùxiá , děng xì zhēn tíng wěn , cái dào : " hái zài tóngyìn xiàn lǐ . "
pairs.english: Xu Cen opened the case, waited for the fine needle to settle, then said, “Still within the Bronze Seal line.”
pairs.hanzi: 许岑打开木匣，等细针停稳，才道：“还在铜印线里。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé píngcháng , lín zhào quèméinéng bǎ mùguāng cóng nàchǎng yǔ shàngyí kāi .
pairs.english: She spoke casually, but Lin Zhao could not draw her gaze away from that rain.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得平常，林照却没能把目光从那场雨上移开。

pairs.target: yǔ xié zhe chuānguò shíjiē , jiē páng yì cóng xìcháng de yèzi bèi dǎ dé zhí huàng , kě mùzhù shàng de shéng máo wénsībúdòng , jiǎoxià de shíxiè yě shì gān de .
pairs.english: Rain slanted across the steps, battering a clump of long, narrow leaves beside them until they shook, yet the rope fibers on the wooden posts did not stir, and the stone chips underfoot were dry too.
pairs.hanzi: 雨斜着穿过石阶，阶旁一丛细长的叶子被打得直晃，可木柱上的绳毛纹丝不动，脚下的石屑也是干的。

pairs.target: tā mànmàn shēnchūshǒu , zhǎngxīn cháo shàng , tíng zài shéng qián .
pairs.english: Slowly she held out her hand, palm upward, and stopped just before the rope.
pairs.hanzi: 她慢慢伸出手，掌心朝上，停在绳前。

pairs.target: méiyǒu yìdīshuǐ luòxiàlái .
pairs.english: Not a single drop of water fell.
pairs.hanzi: 没有一滴水落下来。
